record.field: Create or update a CRM lead only when there is a real commercial signal. Before calling this tool, classify the lead temperature as cold/warm/hot. Do not create leads for cold conversations or casual questions without concrete follow-up intent. Create/update only when warm/hot and there is actionable contact/progression data. For WhatsApp/Evolution channels the phone number is usually resolved automatically from the channel metadata. If it is not available and the customer has not provided it during the conversation, ask for it before calling this tool.

result = { 'success': True, 'lead_id': False, 'message': '', 'created': False, 'updated': False, 'skipped': False, } try: from markupsafe import Markup import re room_id = room.id if room else False agent_id = agent.id if agent else False def _clean(value): if value is None: return '' return str(value).strip() def _normalize_plain_text(value): text = _clean(value) if not text: return '' # Some providers send HTML snippets; normalize to plain text blocks. text = re.sub(r'', '\n', text, flags=re.IGNORECASE) text = re.sub(r'', '\n', text, flags=re.IGNORECASE) text = re.sub(r']*>', '', text, flags=re.IGNORECASE) text = re.sub(r'<[^>]+>', '', text) lines = [line.strip() for line in text.splitlines() if line.strip()] return '\n'.join(lines) # Get parameters name = _clean(params.get('name')) or (room.display_name if room else False) or 'Lead from chat' contact_name = _clean(params.get('contact_name')) email = _clean(params.get('email')).lower() phone = _clean(params.get('phone')) description = _normalize_plain_text(params.get('description')) intent_signal = _normalize_plain_text(params.get('intent_signal')) lead_temperature = _clean(params.get('lead_temperature')).lower() sentiment_summary = _normalize_plain_text(params.get('sentiment_summary')) preferred_contact_time = _normalize_plain_text(params.get('preferred_contact_time')) next_action = _normalize_plain_text(params.get('next_action')) connector_type = _clean(room.connector_id.connector_type if room and room.connector_id else False).lower() # Resolve an internal user for CRM writes to avoid Public user ownership. # Do NOT fall back to agent.create_uid — that causes the agent configurator # to appear as the CRM record author in the chatter. if room and room.assigned_to_id and not room.assigned_to_id.share: execution_user = room.assigned_to_id else: execution_user = env.ref('base.user_admin') # Salesperson: only set when the room is explicitly assigned to an internal user. salesperson_user = False if room and room.assigned_to_id and not room.assigned_to_id.share: salesperson_user = room.assigned_to_id lead_model = env['crm.lead'].sudo().with_user(execution_user) use_lead_group = env.ref('crm.group_use_lead', raise_if_not_found=False) crm_use_lead = bool(use_lead_group and use_lead_group.users) target_type = 'lead' if crm_use_lead else 'opportunity' room_external_id = _clean(room.external_id if room else False) # Fallback phone from linked partner. if not phone and room and room.partner_ids: partner_phone = _clean(room.partner_ids[0].phone or room.partner_ids[0].mobile) if partner_phone: phone = partner_phone # Fallback phone from room.external_id for Evolution/WhatsApp channels. # Since the webhook fix, external_id is set to the real phone number (no '@' suffix). # Ignore LID values that still contain '@' (old rooms created before the fix). if not phone and connector_type in ('evolution',) and room_external_id and '@' not in room_external_id: digits = ''.join(c for c in room_external_id if c.isdigit() or c == '+') if sum(1 for c in digits if c.isdigit()) >= 8: phone = digits if lead_temperature not in ('cold', 'warm', 'hot'): lead_temperature = '' temperature_label_map = { 'cold': 'fría', 'warm': 'tibia', 'hot': 'caliente', } def _build_note(base_description): parts = [] if base_description: parts.append(base_description) if intent_signal: parts.append(f"Señal de intención: {intent_signal}") if lead_temperature: temp_label = temperature_label_map.get(lead_temperature, lead_temperature) parts.append(f"Temperatura del lead: {temp_label}") if sentiment_summary: parts.append(f"Sentimiento: {sentiment_summary}") if preferred_contact_time: parts.append(f"Horario preferido de contacto: {preferred_contact_time}") if next_action: parts.append(f"Próxima acción: {next_action}") # crm.lead.description is HTML-friendly in many setups; use visible line breaks. return '
'.join(parts).strip() note_text = _build_note(description) # Qualification guardrails: skip creation for weak/early intent. joined_text = ' '.join([ name, description, intent_signal, next_action, sentiment_summary, ]).lower() explicit_create = any( token in joined_text for token in [ 'crear lead', 'create lead', 'contactame', 'contáctame', 'llamame', 'llámame', 'cotizacion', 'cotización', 'financiacion', 'financiación', 'test ride', 'prueba de manejo', 'comprar', 'señar', 'reserva', ] ) has_contact_data = bool(contact_name or email or phone) has_detailed_need = len(description) >= 25 has_channel_reachability = bool(room_external_id and connector_type) has_progress_signal = bool(intent_signal or next_action or preferred_contact_time) # Heuristic fallback for temperature if model did not send it. if not lead_temperature: if explicit_create and has_contact_data: lead_temperature = 'hot' elif has_contact_data and has_detailed_need: lead_temperature = 'warm' else: lead_temperature = 'cold' # Never create cold leads. if lead_temperature == 'cold': result['success'] = False result['skipped'] = True result['message'] = 'Lead skipped: temperature is cold.' raise ValueError(result['message']) qualifies_for_creation = ( # Classic path: explicit commercial intent + contact data. (explicit_create and has_contact_data) # Conservative fallback: contact data + concrete need summary. or (has_contact_data and has_detailed_need) # Channel-based path (Telegram/WhatsApp/etc.): warm/hot with # clear progression signal even when phone/email is not provided yet. or ( lead_temperature in ('warm', 'hot') and has_channel_reachability and has_detailed_need and has_progress_signal ) ) if not qualifies_for_creation: result['success'] = False result['skipped'] = True result['message'] = ( 'Lead skipped: insufficient qualification for warm/hot lead.' ) raise ValueError(result['message']) probability_by_temp = { 'warm': 40.0, 'hot': 70.0, } priority_by_temp = { 'warm': '1', 'hot': '2', } # Find a lead already linked to this room — prevents double-creation # when the AI calls the tool more than once for the same conversation. existing_lead = None if room_id and 'chatroom_room_ids' in env['crm.lead']._fields: existing_lead = lead_model.search( [('chatroom_room_ids', 'in', [room_id]), ('type', 'in', ['lead', 'opportunity'])], limit=1, order='id desc' ) if existing_lead: update_vals = {} if contact_name and not existing_lead.contact_name: update_vals['contact_name'] = contact_name if email and not existing_lead.email_from: update_vals['email_from'] = email if phone and not existing_lead.phone: update_vals['phone'] = phone if ( salesperson_user and (not existing_lead.user_id or existing_lead.user_id.share) ): update_vals['user_id'] = salesperson_user.id if description: previous = existing_lead.description or '' if note_text and note_text not in previous: update_vals['description'] = ( f"{previous}\n\n[AI update]\n{note_text}".strip() ) if update_vals: existing_lead.write(update_vals) # Upgrade commercial priority based on latest temperature. current_probability = existing_lead.probability or 0.0 target_probability = probability_by_temp.get(lead_temperature, current_probability) if target_probability > current_probability: existing_lead.write({'probability': target_probability}) target_priority = priority_by_temp.get(lead_temperature) if target_priority and (existing_lead.priority or '0') < target_priority: existing_lead.write({'priority': target_priority}) if room_id and 'chatroom_room_ids' in env['crm.lead']._fields: existing_lead.write({'chatroom_room_ids': [(4, room_id)]}) result['lead_id'] = existing_lead.id result['updated'] = True result['message'] = f'Existing lead updated (ID: {existing_lead.id})' lead = existing_lead else: # Create lead lead_vals = { 'name': name, 'contact_name': contact_name or False, 'email_from': email or False, 'phone': phone or False, 'user_id': salesperson_user.id if salesperson_user else False, 'description': note_text, 'type': target_type, 'probability': probability_by_temp.get(lead_temperature, 0.0), 'priority': priority_by_temp.get(lead_temperature, '0'), } # Link to chat room if available if room_id and 'chatroom_room_ids' in env['crm.lead']._fields: lead_vals['chatroom_room_ids'] = [(4, room_id)] # Link to partner if chat has linked contacts if room and room.partner_ids: lead_vals['partner_id'] = room.partner_ids[0].id lead = lead_model.create(lead_vals) result['lead_id'] = lead.id result['created'] = True lead_label = 'Lead' if target_type == 'lead' else 'Opportunity' result['message'] = ( f'{lead_label} "{name}" created successfully (ID: {lead.id})' ) # Add message with creation info if room_id and agent_id: agent = env['chatroom.ai.agent'].browse(agent_id) chat_url = f"/web#action=chatroom.action_chatroom_app&room_id={room_id}" action_txt = 'created' if result['created'] else 'updated' message_body = f'''

This lead was automatically {action_txt} by AI agent {agent.name} from a chat conversation.

View source chat conversation

''' lead.with_user(execution_user).message_post( body=Markup(message_body), subject='Lead managed by AI', message_type='comment', subtype_xmlid='mail.mt_note', author_id=( execution_user.partner_id.id if execution_user and execution_user.partner_id else False ), ) except Exception as e: if not result.get('skipped'): result['success'] = False result['message'] = f'Error creating/updating lead: {str(e)}'

Update an existing CRM lead/opportunity with new information gathered during the conversation. Use this tool AFTER create_lead has already created the lead for this chat. Do NOT use this to create a new lead — use create_lead for that. Call this when the customer provides additional contact data (phone, email), updates their intent, confirms a next action, or the temperature changes. The lead_id is returned by create_lead; if not available, it will be resolved automatically from the current chat room.
